product_metadata.title: iDesign Linus Kitchen, Pantry, Refrigerator, Freezer Storage Container - Small, Clear
features: PLASTIC FOOD STORAGE BIN: Great for creating a clean and organized refrigerator or pantry. Ideal for yogurts, canned goods, food packets, cheese, meat, drink boxes, baby food, juices, boxed foods, fruits, and veggies. Maximize storage space in refrigerator, freezer, cabinets, cupboards, or pantry shelves
DURABLE: Constructed of BPA-free, break-resistant, resipreme plastic for years of quality use
OPEN FRONT DESIGN: Open front and top makes it easy to grab what you need and go!
EASY VISIBILITY: Transparent plastic walls allow you to easily view box contents
IDEAL SIZE: Each bin measures 11.1" x 3.6" x 3.5" to fit in any space
description: The iDesign Linus Fridge and Freezer Storage Organizer Bins are the perfect solution for organizing any kitchen. These versatile bins are made of clear durable plastic to last for years of quality use. The open top design makes seeing and stocking your items easy! The textured bottom prevents the contents from sliding around. Organizing your fridge has never been easier. Store fruits, veggies, meats, cheeses, dry food, snacks, and more in the bin and place in the fridge or freezer! The iDesign Linus Fridge and Freezer Storage Organizer Bin measures 11.1" x 3.6" x 3.5", compact enough for any space.
With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
